record.question: If the factory incurs a loss in years when production is below 70 thousand units, for how many years did the factory face a loss?
record.explanation: The original graph labels production as 60, 65, 72, 78, 85 and 90 thousand units for 2018–2023. Only 2018 and 2019 are below 70, so there are two loss years, option B. Use the numeric labels rather than the inconsistent bar lengths. Verified worked solution; unofficial. No matching official answer key was found in the targeted source search on 24 October 2026.
record.direction: Direction (Questions 73–75): The bar graph below shows the annual production (in thousand units) of a factory from 2018 to 2023.
record.passage:
Annual production (thousand units), as labelled in the source graph:
2018: 60
2019: 65
2020: 72
2021: 78
2022: 85
2023: 90

The original graph is preserved below. The printed bar lengths are not consistently proportional to these numeric labels.
